propositions: reconcile-bridge-canary.yml contains ~200 lines of production logic in YAML run-blocks (staleness classification, alert-ticket lifecycle state machines) that is untestable and unlintable

logic families for heartbeat and binding-drift alert lifecycle management need extraction into a testable Python module with unit tests while preserving existing failure modes and error handling dispositions
canary flush loop and git commit-back push logic must remain in YAML byte-identical to pre-migration state and covered by verbatim-execution tests
anti-rot tests must pin the canary wiring to prevent logic-bearing run-blocks from reappearing and to verify workflow invokes the canonical Python entry point
operator-attested parity validation post-merge confirms classification and alert behavior match pre-migration scheduled runs
